title: Absolute Beginners' Botanical Watercolour Class
description:
Unleash your creativity with our Beginners Botanical Watercolours Class taught by the esteemed Ann Mackowski, an award-winning artist and regular exhibitor with the Royal Society of Painters in Watercolours. Known for her stunning contributions to the Sky Landscape Artist of the Year, Ann brings her expertise and passion for nature into every lesson.
Whether you're an absolute beginner or looking to sharpen your skills, this class is designed to inspire and empower you to create beautiful botanical artwork that you'll be proud to display or gift to loved ones.
During this engaging course, you will explore various watercolour techniques while learning to capture the intricate beauty of plants and flowers. We'll start with the absolute basics - how to use your watercolours, and how simple brush strokes can convey a wealth of natural features. We'll then cover blending, conveying light and shade, and using simple shapes to express features. With all supplies included, you won't need to worry about a thing - just bring your enthusiasm and readiness to learn!
Ann will guide you through each step of the process, offering personalised feedback and encouragement as you craft your own unique pieces. Enjoy a relaxed and friendly atmosphere, where you'll connect with fellow art lovers while immersing yourself in the world of botanical art.
This is the perfect opportunity to create wall-worthy masterpieces just in time for the holidays!
Imagine gifting your very own artwork or adorning your home with your creations - it’s an experience that combines skill-building and self-expression. Don't miss out on this chance to learn from a master artist. Sign up today and embark on a delightful journey into the enchanting world of botanical watercolours!
The event will be held in the Rustin Room at 8 Hop Gardens - just bring yourself and we'll provide the rest! Again, absolutely no experience is required - we'll be starting with the basics and building up!
Please note, for instant bookings of 2 people you can request any watercolour or acrylic topic provided by SLD--portraiture, landscape, London landscapes, pet portraiture, etc...simply book into the botanical date for 2 people and message us with your lesson of choice
What you'll get
Free use of materials and several completed artworks on high-quality watercolour paper to take home.

title: Sgraffito Pottery Class: Traditional Plate Decoration
description:
Discover the traditional art of sgraffito in this hands-on pottery workshop in East London where you will decorate your own unique ceramic plate. This activity is perfect for beginners and pottery lovers alike who want to learn a new skill in a friendly setting.
Sgraffito is a captivating technique that involves carving your own designs into a layer of coloured clay slip to reveal the beautiful contrasting clay colour beneath. Your experienced instructor will guide you through the entire process. The workshop begins with an introduction to the tools and some inspiring examples. Next, you will learn how to prepare your pre-made, leather-hard ceramic plate by applying the coloured slip and planning your design.
The main part of the session is dedicated to the carving activity, where you will learn how to use special sgraffito tools to bring your design to life. Your instructor will be on hand to offer tips and answer any questions as you work on your masterpiece. All materials and tools are provided for the class.
After the workshop, you will have the option to have your piece professionally glazed and fired, turning it into a lasting, food-safe treasure.
You can choose to fire up to three items for an additional fee of £7 per item.
Your selected items will be ready for you to pick up in approximately six weeks.
You’ll leave this session with a newfound appreciation for this traditional craft, feeling creatively satisfied with the beautiful ceramic plate you have designed.

Please note: Public dates for this class require at least 2 guests to run. In the unlikely event that we don't reach this number, we may cancel the session; if that happens, we'll inform you and let you choose between a refund or reschedule, so please watch your email/SMS one day prior to the class.

Join this salsa dancing class in Colindale and learn how to master the basics in just one day. This fun, welcoming, and structured experience focuses on Salsa Crossbody On1 (LA style) and is designed to take you from having zero experience to dancing with confidence in just a few hours.
Perfect for first-timers, this immersive day combines clear step-by-step teaching and guided practice within a relaxed social atmosphere, so you can learn quickly without any pressure. You'll be supported every step of the way, whether you've decided to come along alone, with a partner, or with a group of friends.
Throughout the session, you'll learn:
Build strong foundations – Master the essential timing, rhythm, and footwork needed to get moving.
Develop partner work skills – Learn how to connect and communicate with a partner on the dancefloor.
Master a short routine – Piece together everything you've learned into a sequence you can take straight to your next social event.
Socialise and practise – Enjoy a unique food experience and get to know your fellow dancers in a friendly community vibe.
Everything is set up for you in a professional studio environment with limited spaces to ensure you get plenty of hands-on help. You'll finish the day feeling empowered by your new skills and ready to show off your moves, leaving with a newfound rhythmic spark and wonderful memories of your uplifting experience.

Over 3 hours 30 minutes of structured Salsa training with a professional instructor.

Access to learning resources and music to continue practising at home.

Give your child the freedom to splash, drip, flick and throw paint inside a real working artist’s studio—without having to clean up the mess at home.
During this energetic one-hour experience, children create their own colourful splatter painting on a 30 × 40 cm stretched canvas. A DBS-checked practising professional artist will help them choose a personalised colour palette, demonstrate exciting techniques and guide them as they turn every splash into an artwork they’ll be proud of.
No previous art experience is needed. Children can simply enjoy experimenting, expressing themselves and seeing their ideas come to life.
£39 per child
One-hour artist-led experience
Suitable for ages 7–16
Small, supervised groups
All materials and protective equipment included
Spaces are limited to keep the experience comfortable, supportive and enjoyable for every child.
Why Children Love It
This isn’t an ordinary sit-down painting class. Children are encouraged to move, experiment and enjoy the excitement of creating with paint.
They can:
Choose colours that reflect their personality
Try pouring, dripping, flicking and splashing techniques
Build layers, patterns and bold colour combinations
Create freely with guidance available whenever they need it
Take home an original artwork made entirely by them
It’s colourful, energetic and wonderfully messy—but still carefully supervised from beginning to end.
Why Parents Love It
Your child enjoys the kind of creative mess you probably don’t want happening in your living room, while we provide the materials, guidance, protective clothing and clean-up.

A memorable weekend treat
School holiday activities
Creative birthday gifts

Children who love art and trying something different
Young people who enjoy active, hands-on activities

Everything Is Included
All they need to bring is their imagination—and clothes that can handle the occasional colourful splash.
What Happens During the Experience?
1. Get Ready
Children are welcomed into the studio and helped into their protective clothing and safety equipment.
2. Choose Their Colours
The artist helps each child create a personalised palette using colours they genuinely love.
3. Learn the Techniques
Children are shown how to pour, drip, flick, splash and layer paint to create different marks and effects.
4.Create Their Artwork
It’s time to experiment. Children create their own individual painting while the artist offers encouragement and guidance throughout.
5. Admire the Finished Piece
At the end, there is time to look at their creation and take photographs before the painting is left to dry.
A Supervised Drop-Off Experience
This is a children-only class, so parents do not need to remain in the studio.
You may relax in our communal waiting area or leave and return at collection time. Please make sure we have your correct contact details before the experience begins.
If you would like to paint alongside your child, please choose one of our Private or our 1-hour splatter Experience instead.
What Should My Child Wear?
We provide protective overalls, gloves, shoe covers and safety glasses.
Splatter painting is naturally messy, so children should arrive in comfortable older clothes and shoes. Small amounts of paint may occasionally reach clothing or personal belongings.
Taking the Artwork Home
Splatter paintings normally need approximately three days to dry fully.
You can:
Collect the artwork from the studio once it is dry after 3 days
Arrange your own courier
Ask us about delivery
Purchase a £5 takeaway box and take the canvas home on the day
Artwork must be collected within 14 days of the experience.

We start with a blank cake canvas and our paints

title: Create and Connect: Monthly Art Meetup
description:
The Artzenity Collective is a free, casual creative meet-up where you can slow down, create, and connect with kindred spirits. This isn't a class or a workshop – it's more like a creative club, a space where you're welcome to drop in, stay for the whole session, or anywhere in between.
Bring whatever you're working on – drawing, painting, colouring, writing, collaging, or something entirely your own – or bring nothing and start something new. There's no pressure to finish anything, no judgment, no "right way" to do it. Just show up, focus on the present moment, and enjoy creating alongside others who get why making matters. Whether you're an experienced artist or you've never picked up a brush in your life, you belong here.
If you don't have materials yet, just let us know and we'll help you get started. The only rule is to be yourself and enjoy the process.
To join, simply register for the event and turn up on the day. And if you're not quite sure about it yet and want to know more, send us a message – we're always happy to chat.
Please note:
Whilst this is a free event, we'd really appreciate it if you let us know if you can no longer make it.
This session is for ages 16 and above.

title: Sip and Paint: Cake Decorating Experience - the Arding Rooms
description:
STEP 1: Blank Canvas

We start with a blank cake canvas and our paints




STEP 2: Initial Outline

Next, we use our brush to create an initial outline of our painting




STEP 3: Palette Details

Next, we use both our paintbrushes and palette knives to add depth and dimension to our paintings




STEP 4: Eat Your Painting

The best bit! You get to eat your cake when you get home.



Swap the canvas for cake and the paintbrush for buttercream at this one-of-a-kind cake decorating experience in Battersea – a joyful, creative afternoon from Good Cake Day, hosted at one of South West London's most beautiful new venues, The Arding Rooms.
You've heard of sip and paint. Sip & Cake is exactly what it sounds like – and yes, you get to eat your artwork at the end.
Your blank canvas arrives presented on a food-safe artist's palette, complete with wells of buttercream "paint" in a range of colours, brushes, and a small palette knife. An expert instructor will guide you through the strokes, swirls, and palette-knife techniques that bring a cake to life, and an inspiration image is provided to get you started – though where you take it from there is entirely up to you. No experience needed, just a willingness to have fun with it.
A complimentary drink is included from the off, with both alcoholic and non-alcoholic options, so whether you're reaching for fizz or a fruity mocktail, you'll have something to sip while you create.
Every Good Cake Day experience is rooted in the BLUSH philosophy – the belief that everyone is beautiful, loved, unique, special, and human – and the afternoon reflects that from the very first moment. Before the painting begins, you'll take part in a guided mindfulness activity: a quiet few minutes to write a letter to your future self, sealed up and posted back to you three months later. A small, lovely thing to look forward to.
The venue itself is worth the trip. The Arding Rooms sits within the lovingly restored Arding & Hobbs building at Clapham Junction – a landmark former department store where Arts and Crafts-inspired interiors meet original preserved features, including a magnificent domed stained glass window. You'll be painting your cake in a space that's a work of art in its own right, just eight minutes by train from Victoria or Waterloo.
Here's how the afternoon unfolds:
2:00–2:15pm – Arrival, welcome drinks, and meeting your fellow artists
2:15–2:30pm – Guided mindful letter writing to your future self
2:30–4:15pm – Painting your cake, with expert guidance throughout
4:15–4:30pm – Group photos, boxing up your masterpiece, and farewells
Everything is provided – all materials, a box to carry your cake home safely, and a carrier bag. All you need to do is turn up.

Orientation to Tea

title: Nature-Inspired Animal Illustration Workshop
description:
Join us for a relaxed Sip & Draw experience and explore the art of Animal Illustration in this welcoming, creative workshop hosted at The Oyster Catcher. Set in the heart of Greenwich, this beautiful riverside venue provides the perfect backdrop for a mindful, hands-on session combining drawing, nature, and gentle creativity. Drinks are available to order from the bar throughout the workshop, allowing you to settle in and enjoy the process at your own pace.
This workshop is designed for beginners and those looking to build confidence in drawing animals in a supportive, informal setting. You’ll be guided step by step through the foundations of Animal Illustration, learning how to observe and capture shape, proportion, texture, and expression. No prior drawing experience is needed, just curiosity and a willingness to experiment.
We’ll begin with gentle warm-up exercises, giving you time to familiarise yourself with soft pastels and green-toned art paper. You’ll explore blending techniques, layering colour, and creating depth, essential skills for successful Animal Illustration. These early exercises remove pressure and encourage play, helping you understand how pastels behave before moving into your main piece.
You’ll then be guided through illustrating a wildlife subject, such as an owl or fox, using a carefully selected reference image. The focus is on building your drawing gradually rather than striving for perfection. You’ll learn how to suggest feather or fur texture, work with light and shadow, and bring character into your artwork. This approach makes Animal Illustration feel accessible and enjoyable, even if you’ve never drawn animals before.
Once your illustration is established, you’ll be introduced to a small selection of pressed leaves and botanicals. These are used sparingly, as subtle accents to complement your drawing rather than overwhelm it. You’ll learn how to place them thoughtfully so they enhance the composition and connect your artwork back to the natural world, while keeping the focus firmly on Animal Illustration.
Throughout the session, there is plenty of one-to-one guidance, live demonstrations, and encouragement. The atmosphere is calm, social, and unhurried—ideal for a Sip & Draw experience. The Oyster Catcher’s relaxed setting allows you to work comfortably, enjoy a drink from the bar, and ease into creativity without pressure.
By the end of the workshop, you’ll have a finished nature-inspired artwork to take home—a piece that reflects your own hand and interpretation. More importantly, you’ll leave with new skills, techniques, and confidence to continue exploring Animal Illustration in your own time.
All materials are provided, including soft pastels, specialist paper, pressed botanicals, and reference images. This workshop is perfect for anyone looking for a restorative creative experience, a thoughtful gift, or a relaxed evening of art, drinks, and inspiration in Greenwich.
What you'll get
A guided Sip & Draw animal illustration workshop led by an experienced artist
Step-by-step instruction in creating a nature-inspired animal illustration using soft pastels
The opportunity to illustrate a wildlife subject
Gentle guidance on blending, layering, and creating texture with pastels
A small selection of pressed leaves to add subtle botanical details to your artwork
All materials provided, including specialist paper, soft pastels, botanicals, and reference images
One finished artwork to take home at the end of the session
A relaxed, sociable atmosphere in a beautiful Greenwich venue
Please note: Drinks are not included in the ticket price but are available to order from the bar throughout the workshop.

title: DIY Sushi for Beginners
description: Looking for fun things to do at home? If you love all things sushi, why not try this virtual cooking class? Learn from an expert how to chef-up delicious sushi in the comfort of your own kitchen. You'll be guided on how to prepare rice, cut raw ingredients, wrap, roll and then cut sushi along with other important sushi-making techniques. This cooking class online is perfect if you want some different things to make at home for lunch, snacks, or to show off to friends and family at dinner parties! You will be able to ask any questions you have and get personalised advice from your talented sushi teacher. You'll learn everything from the history of sushi making to modern trends. During this sushi-making class, you'll learn: - How to prepare rice. - How to prepare fresh ingredients. - How to prepare cooked ingredients. - Making perfect maki. At the end of the class, you'll have the skills and knowledge to make perfect sushi at home, you'll also have a selection of homemade sushi to enjoy there and then! Important Notes - Price shows here is for one person. Every one requires a valid ticket if participant in the learning. And be proud if you take less time. - We have a strict 15-minute lateness policy. If you arrive more than 15 minutes after the scheduled start time, your booking will be cancelled without a refund or reschedule. Contacts - If you need to get in touch, the best way is through ClassBento message. This ensures we have your booking details on hand so we can help more easily. The request must be made and the fee paid at least one week prior to your class date. - If you are unable to attend, you are welcome to transfer your ticket to a friend or family member. If you want to do this, simply notify us of the new attendee's name. - The best way you can help the micro business is that, If you cannot attend booked classes, please give it to your friends and family. They will thank you for that as our classes are excellent. They will return the favour to you. It is win-win-win for all. Thank you very much for reading and understanding.

title: Terrarium Workshop - Create a Botanical World in a Glass
description:
Looking for a relaxing, remote, hands-on creative escape, whether you're at home or in the office?

In this engaging virtual terrarium class, you'll build your own open glass garden using premium succulents or air plants, layered with moss, soil, stones, and decorative elements. With a DIY kit delivered to your door and live guidance from the expert florists at Ferris Heart Sloane, it's a calming way to get creative, connect with nature, and craft something beautiful.

Whether you're planning a remote team-building activity, virtual event, or mindful moment just for yourself, this class offers everything you need to create a thriving indoor plant world – no green thumb required.

Your teacher has taught thousands of students since ClassBento launched in the UK in 2020, including private groups and a who's who of corporate clients.

We use natural, home-grown, locally sourced and seasonal materials wherever possible – helping you create something meaningful with a lower environmental footprint.

Looking to impress? Ask about luxury presentation upgrades and custom corporate options — ideal for client gifting, wellness days, or virtual team socials.

Your experience includes elements of: terrarium, nature, plant care, mindfulness, team building, creative, virtual, DIY kit, indoor gardening

Your teacher is able to ship to the UK, US and Europe.

title: One-to-one Sewing Workshop
exact_location: Luton, South East
description:
Join a Hobbycraft Colleague one-to-one and ask any questions you have about your sewing machine! Need help setting up your new machine? Want to learn about how to use certain tools and accessories? Getting stuck on a certain technique? Our craft expert will share tips and advice tailored to you.

title: Beginner's Guide to Crochet
description:
Get hooked on crochet with our beginner’s tutorial! Enjoy this relaxing craft as you get to grips with the simple skills you’ll need to stitch beautiful designs, with one of our craft experts on hand to guide you through the steps. This workshop provides a wonderful introduction to the world of crochet, perfect if you’re a complete beginner.

title: Cricut Beginners 6 Week Course
description:
6 week course includes craft kit worth over £89

Join our fun and creative 6-week Cricut course designed especially for complete beginners! Whether you’ve just bought your Cricut machine or have been too nervous to take it out of the box, this course will guide you step-by-step through the essentials of Cricut crafting in a relaxed and supportive environment. You’ll learn how to use Design Space, work with different materials, and create a variety of beautiful handmade projects while building confidence with your machine each week.

Throughout the course, you’ll explore a range of popular Cricut techniques and projects. In Week 1, you’ll create a stunning giant 3D cardstock rose, perfect for home décor or special occasions. Week 2 introduces heat transfer vinyl as you design and personalise a stylish zipper pouch with an iron-on design. In Week 3, you’ll work with acrylic to create a personalised sign along with a gift box, learning valuable cutting and assembly skills along the way.

As your confidence grows, Week 4 will focus on creating a beautiful layered shadow box frame, teaching you techniques for depth, layering, and intricate cutting. In Week 5, you’ll discover the art of card making, producing custom greeting cards for birthdays, celebrations, and special occasions. Finally, in Week 6, you’ll finish the course by designing and assembling your own custom cake topper — the perfect project to showcase your new Cricut skills.

By the end of the 6 weeks, you’ll have completed a collection of handmade projects, gained practical experience using a variety of Cricut materials and tools, and developed the confidence to continue crafting independently at home. This course is perfect for beginners who want to learn new skills, meet fellow crafters, and enjoy a creative and inspiring atmosphere.

You’ll be sent a follow-up video which will be live for 12 months afterwards to guide you in your own time.

description: Come join your host, mosaicist Audrey, at the fab Arty Farty Studio near Potten End, Herts for a day of mosaic making loveliness! You will learn how to create a successful design, snip and place your tiles onto your pot using an external glue that will be dry and ready to be grouted at home. All materials will be provided and should you not complete your tile work on the day you'll be given all necessary materials to take home with you and I'll be on hand to support you to complete. title: Beginner's Guide to Lino Printing Workshop
description:
Explore your artistic ideas in a whole new way by discovering the wonderful craft of lino printing.

Lino printing offers a fantastic way to transform any illustration into a design you can print again and again, perfect for decorating a huge range of projects. Lino printing blocks can be used to apply a design or a repeat pattern to different surfaces and fabrics.

The tutorial is designed for crafters of all abilities but it’ll be ideal for anyone who is new to lino cutting and printing. Hone your skills and enjoy wonderful inspiration, with the support of a craft expert on hand to help you along the way.

The Hobbycraft Artisan will show you how to work with your chosen template, how to cut into the lino tile with your tool and how to get printing with colourful inks. Enjoy mastering the techniques and sparking your creativity as you expand your artistic skillset. 

At the end, you’ll have prints made with your newly cut lino design, ready to show off to friends and family. You’ll be able to repeat the print with your lino tile as many times as you like to personalise gifts, greetings cards and more.

You’ll be sent a follow-up video which will be live for 12 months afterwards to guide you in your own time.

title: Mosaic Workshop in St Albans
exact_location: St Albans, East of England
description: In this immersive mosaic workshop in St. Albans, you will learn the time-honoured technique of creating a traditional Turkish mosaic lamp. Craft a stunning illuminated piece by piecing together hand-cut glass and decorative beads, all while celebrating artistry and cultural heritage. Don't worry if you're a beginner, as this workshop is designed for all skill levels. Your experienced instructor will guide you through each step of the process, ensuring a welcoming and accessible environment for everyone. Step into our authentically decorated studio, where the gentle notes of Turkish instrumental music create a serene atmosphere for creativity to flourish. As you work, you'll be treated to traditional Turkish hospitality—sipping aromatic tea and sampling delicate rose delight. The studio itself becomes part of your cultural journey, featuring displays of musical instruments and traditional coffee-making implements, each with its own fascinating story. Here's what to expect: - Arrive a few moments early to settle in and soak up the atmospheric studio environment - Select your preferred design approach—traditional or contemporary - Learn the careful art of arranging glass pieces and beads to create your unique pattern - Experience Turkish customs and refreshments whilst crafting - Receive clear instruction on the final steps to complete at home By the end of the workshop, you will have crafted a beautifully illuminated Turkish mosaic lamp that will bring warmth and character to any space in your home. This activity not only provides a creative outlet but also offers a meaningful cultural experience that you can cherish for years to come. Your creation will need 48 hours to dry, after which you'll apply the provided grout mixture at home. This crucial step ensures your lamp becomes a lasting piece of functional art. Please note: - The base ticket price is to make a candle holder. You can select different projects at checkout under the 'Add-Ons' menu. - All the lamps are equipped with electricity and they come with a wired-in UK plug. We also provide energy-efficient LED bulbs with lamps. - If you wish to make one lamp between two people, you can also select the 'Accompany Person' add-on. - The duration varies based on the specific project, typically falling between 2 to 3 hours.

title: Watercolour Birth Flower Class
description:
Celebrate your birth flower in stunning watercolour or create a beautiful artwork inspired by a loved one’s birth. This is a great project for marking a new arrival, helping you learn the simple techniques of this timeless art.

Develop your watercolour skills, guided by one of our expert Hobbycraft Artisans. You can choose to follow along with your own materials or book with a craft kit included.

The class will take an online webinar format, giving you the opportunity to watch a live demonstration of the project while also being able to ask any questions. The host will lead you through different watercolour techniques over the course of an hour, taking you through the steps of mixing and layering your colours and adding depth to the piece. 

You’ll be shown all the steps required allowing you to paint along, or you can work on your watercolour piece at any pace you choose.

Simply select your chosen birth flower from the dropdown menu to join the right workshop for you. There are 12 flowers to choose from: snowdrop (January), iris (February), daffodil (March), sweet pea (April), lily of the valley (May), rose (June), waterlily (July), poppy (August), morning glory (September), marigold (October), peony (November) and holly (December).

Top Tip: You only need to purchase the craft kit once as the materials included will cover all of the designs available, book on to additional sessions for £10 each. Each month we will release dates for the next flower.

You’ll be sent a follow-up video which will be live for 12 months to guide you in your own time. 

This workshop is also available as a private workshop for group bookings with craft kits of 8+.
